_meta.naming_note: Deliberately NOT renamed: fed by two report types, and Ads-API table names are already Amazon-derived.
_meta.description: Amazon Ads Sponsored Products purchases of a product other than the advertised one (halo), by the product bought, per day (Reporting v3 spPurchasedProduct and its 14-day backfill). Retired: v3 report collection stopped for every store on 2026-11-20; Ads data from 2026-09-01 is in rpt_ads_converted_product_daily (ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'), and this table is deleted on 2026-12-31.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 400 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note
_meta.dedup_note: 2026-07-15 calibration: 56-64% of rows were duplicates (NULL target_id in a NULLS-DISTINCT unique key defeated upsert dedup). Constraint rebuilt NULLS NOT DISTINCT + history deduped keeping the latest ingest per key. SUM aggregates computed before this date were inflated.
caveats: For any day from 2026-09-01 read rpt_ads_converted_product_daily with ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'; use this table only for days before 2026-09-01, until it is deleted on 2026-12-31. Split a range at 2026-09-01 and never add the two: the same Ads data is in both.

Columns there: purchased_asin → converted_asin; this table's other-SKU columns are the rows with product_relevance = 'Brand halo' there: purchases_other_sku_7d → purchases, sales_other_sku_7d → sales, units_sold_other_sku_7d → units_sold (7 days for a seller, attribution_window_days); Stream also holds the advertised product's own purchases, as 'Promoted', which this table left out; the keyword and target columns have no twin at this grain; campaign and ad group names from rpt_ads_campaigns / rpt_ads_ad_groups; currency_code → currency.
Its rows stop on 2026-11-20, when v3 collection ended for every store (its schedules read superseded_by_stream): its newest day is not the newest Ads data.

columns.note: Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.

Documented opt-outs (2026-07-11): kindleEditionNormalizedPagesRead14d / kindleEditionNormalizedPagesRoyalties14d — KDP-book metrics Amazon ships on every row; no SellerSheet store sells Kindle content, deliberately not promoted.
Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.

Row ingest timestamp (UTC). Bookkeeping, not business data. UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
